svg.text: Simple CRM — Technical Architecture & API Schema
crm-next · Next.js 15.5 (App Router, React 19, Turbopack) · json-server REST API · data/db.json · localhost :3000 / :3001
presence check only — token not validated
1) /crm** without cookie → 307 /login 2) login() validates credentials → sets httpOnly access_token → redirect /crm 3) middleware admits on cookie presence (token not validated)
served by json-server from data/db.json · application/json · no API auth
seeded c1…c5 · nanoid generated if omitted
e.g. VIP, Lead, Referral — may be []
customers 1 — n interactions via customerId (implicit FK; json-server does not validate or enforce it)
app uses read-only GETs; json-server auto-exposes full CRUD (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE)
no API authentication — development seed data only
